description: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (India) -- mandatory declarations, unit-price tolerance, and origin/best-before requirements, expressed as data for the generic rule engine. This file is regulation-specific DATA; the engine code that evaluates it (backend/engine/) contains no reference to Legal Metrology, MRP, or India.

rules.name: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer name & address declared
rules.description: Every pre-packaged commodity must declare the name and address of the manufacturer, or packer, or importer.

exemptions.description: Product falls under a whole-of-declaration exemption (Rule 24/25/26 class).

rules.message_pass: Manufacturer/packer/importer name and address is declared.
rules.message_fail: Manufacturer/packer/importer name and address is missing from the label.
rules.message_uncertain: Could not confirm presence of the manufacturer/packer/importer declaration from the available evidence.

rules.name: Common / generic name of commodity declared

requirements.description: Net quantity carries a standard unit of weight/volume/count

rules.name: Month & year of manufacture / packing declared
Best before / use by / expiry date declared where required
rules.message_not_applicable: This product's category is not one of the categories the proviso requires a best-before/expiry date for.

rules.name: Maximum Retail Price (MRP), inclusive of all taxes, declared

requirements.description: Declared MRP is a positive amount
Label states MRP is inclusive of all taxes
requirements.message_uncertain: Could not confirm 'inclusive of all taxes' wording near the MRP declaration.

rules.name: Consumer care / grievance contact details declared
Country of origin declared for imported commodities
rules.message_not_applicable: Product is not declared/detected as imported, so country-of-origin marking is not required by this proviso.

rules.name: Net quantity conforms to a Second Schedule standard pack size
rules.message_not_applicable: This commodity category does not have a Second-Schedule standard-pack-size restriction, or none was supplied for comparison.

rules.name: Declared unit sale price matches MRP / net-quantity within tolerance
rules.description: Where a unit sale price is declared, it must be arithmetically consistent with MRP and net quantity within a small rounding tolerance.

derived.name: unit_price_deviation_pct
derived.description: Percentage deviation of the declared unit price from the value computed from MRP/net quantity.

rules.message_pass: Declared unit sale price is within +/-5% of the value computed from MRP and net quantity.
rules.message_fail: Declared unit sale price deviates by more than 5% from the value computed from MRP and net quantity.
rules.message_uncertain: Could not compute the expected unit sale price (MRP, net quantity, or declared unit price missing/unreadable).

rules.name: Net-quantity numerals meet minimum height requirement
rules.message_pass: Measured net-quantity numeral height meets the minimum required for this pack's net-quantity band.
rules.message_fail: Measured net-quantity numeral height is below the minimum required for this pack's net-quantity band.
rules.message_uncertain: Numeral height could not be measured/compared (missing measurement or missing applicable threshold).

rules.name: Declarations on multi-piece and combination packages
rules.description: Where a package contains one or more retail packages, mandatory declarations must appear on the outer package and individual inner packages.

requirements.description: Individual retail packages inside combination/group pack retain required declarations

rules.message_pass: Multi-piece package contains required declarations on outer and inner packages.
rules.message_fail: Multi-piece package is missing required declarations on inner packages.
rules.message_not_applicable: Product is not a multi-piece or combination package.
rules.message_uncertain: Inner package declarations or multipack structure could not be established from available evidence.

rules.name: Export packages offered for sale in India
rules.description: Packages manufactured or packed for export must be repacked or relabelled in accordance with Chapter II before sale in India.

requirements.description: Export package sold domestically carries verified repacking/relabeling compliance declaration

rules.message_pass: Export package offered for domestic sale has verified Chapter II compliance evidence.
rules.message_fail: Export package is offered for domestic sale without required Chapter II relabelling or repacking.
rules.message_not_applicable: Package is not an export-only package offered for domestic sale in India.
rules.message_uncertain: Domestic sale status or repacking compliance cannot be established from available evidence.

rules.name: Exemption for fast food items packed by restaurant or hotel
rules.description: Packages containing fast food items packed by a restaurant, hotel or like establishment are exempt under Rule 26(b).

exemptions.description: Fast food packed by restaurant or hotel is exempt under Rule 26(b)

rules.message_exempt: Product is a fast food item packed by a restaurant or hotel and is exempt under Rule 26(b).
rules.message_pass: Fast food package complies with Rule 26(b).
rules.message_not_applicable: Product is not categorized as fast food under Rule 26(b).

rules.name: Exemption for drug formulations covered under DPCO
rules.description: Scheduled or non-scheduled drug formulations covered by the Drugs (Prices Control) Order are exempt under Rule 26(c).

exemptions.description: Drug formulation covered by applicable Drugs (Prices Control) Order is exempt under Rule 26(c)

rules.message_exempt: Drug formulation covered under Drugs (Prices Control) Order is exempt under Rule 26(c).
rules.message_not_applicable: Product is not a drug formulation subject to Rule 26(c).

rules.name: Registration of manufacturers, packers and importers
rules.description: Enterprise registration of manufacturer, packer or importer under Chapter VI (Rule 27).

requirements.description: Enterprise registration number under Chapter VI is evidenced

rules.message_pass: Entity registration under Rule 27 is verified.
rules.message_fail: Required registration under Rule 27 is missing or unverified.
rules.message_not_applicable: Inspection target is a physical package label; enterprise registration under Rule 27 is outside the scope of package-surface declarations.

rules.name: Declarations in advertisements mentioning retail sale price
rules.description: Where an advertisement mentions retail sale price, net quantity must also be prominently declared.

requirements.description: Advertisement mentioning retail sale price also declares net quantity

rules.message_pass: Advertisement declaring retail sale price includes net quantity declaration.
rules.message_fail: Advertisement mentions retail sale price but omits net quantity declaration.
rules.message_not_applicable: Inspection target is a product package label; advertisement declarations under Rule 31 apply only when inspecting advertisements.
